description:
Personal Finance for macOS

Take control of your finances with WiseBudget, budgeting app built natively for Mac. Whether you manage money in one currency or several, WiseBudget keeps everything organized in one place.

Automatic Bank Sync
Connect your Wise and Monobank accounts to import transactions automatically. No more manual data entry — your expenses and income appear in the app with smart categorization based on merchant type and transaction details. Duplicates are detected and skipped, so your records stay clean.

Multi-Currency Support
Working with multiple currencies? WiseBudget converts all transactions to your base currency using real-time exchange rates from Wise. You always see both the original amount and the converted value, giving you a clear picture of your spending across borders.

Budget Planning
Set monthly budgets by category and track your progress throughout the month. See exactly where your money goes and how much room you have left in each category. Adjust your plans as your needs change.

Analytics & Insights
View your financial dashboard with monthly summaries, daily averages, and recent transactions at a glance. Compare spending across months with visual charts broken down by category. Spot trends and make informed decisions about your money.

Flexible Data Import & Export
Import transactions from CSV files — including Wise statements, Monobank exports, or the app's own format. Export all your data anytime for backup or further analysis. Your financial data is always portable and accessible.

Built for Mac
Designed with SwiftUI for a fast, responsive experience that feels right at home on macOS. Your data stays on your device with secure Keychain storage for bank credentials. No subscriptions, no ads — just a straightforward tool for managing your money.
promotionalText: Track expenses effortlessly with Wise and Monobank sync, multi-currency support, budget planning, and detailed analytics — all in one native macOS app
